ledger.x: 30 September 1966: the Bechuanaland Protectorate becomes the independent Republic of Botswana under Seretse Khama.

wars.name: Kasikili/Sedudu Island dispute (Botswana and Namibia)
wars.outcome: 'A long-running dispute over the northern border with Namibia's Caprivi Strip was the subject of a ruling by the International Court of Justice in December 1999.

certainty.note: The frontier is the protectorate's: its northern boundary 'was formally extended northward by the British to include Ngamiland' (30 June 1890, protectorate page) and the Caprivi strip was created by the Heligoland-Zanzibar Treaty.
